subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue stop at documenting the inherited TUI multiline bindings, or should OpenClaw establish its own persistent send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Runtime multiline behavior already exists upstream, but exposing a new config or CLI surface creates a lasting compatibility contract and may duplicate upstream keybinding ownership.

options.title: Document inherited bindings
options.body: Add Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback to TUI docs and `/help` without adding configuration.

options.title: Add OpenClaw preference
options.body: Define a canonical TUI send/newline setting or CLI option with schema, help, documentation, fresh-install behavior, upgrade behavior, and focused tests.

recommendation.title: Document inherited bindings
recommendation.body: Add Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-Enter fallback to TUI docs and `/help` without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and prior issue discussion connect them most strongly to the TUI wrapper, documentation, and product-surface decision.
